entities.summary: Tsacho Andreykovski is a Bulgarian boxer. He competed at the 1976 Summer Olympics and the 1980 Summer Olympics. At the 1976 Summer Olympics, he defeated Aldo Cosentino of France, before losing to Ku Yong-jo of North Korea.
